review.notes: Full review. Seeded sample 1.1, 1.2, 2.1, 2.2, 2.3, 2.4, 3.1, 3.2 and all ten theorems of Suggested.lean recomputed (degenerate parameters, every Check, the routes marked Proved here; exact and randomized enumeration on Petersen, cycles, K4, the K9 and 18-vertex decoding examples). 17 locators read in Hoory-Linial-Wigderson, Vadhan and Spielman; Healy (ECCC TR06-058) and Chung 1989 could not be read legally and are listed as not verifiable, with two questions for the author. All cross-roadmap citations resolved at the open heads of the five suppliers (ExpanderConstructions, ExpanderCodes, GraphSpectra, SpectralGraphBounds, IharaZetaFunction), which merge first. Dependency check: 0 problems. Suggested.lean elaborates with only sorry warnings; no theorem closes by a one-tactic probe; signatures compared with the README. The worker's automatic checks all passed. Three source issues recorded for Spielman Chapter 29. Five points for the human reviewers (decoding and the rule on algorithms, relation of 3.1 to ExpanderCodes, results without a published locator, unread sources, ECCC licence class).
